preview.description:
Today, we're launching Zaplar (YC S26)
Zaplar is the agentic hotel operating system built to replace the legacy software hotels use today.
We consolidate PMS, MICE, POS, and more, into one system.
Learn more at https://zaplar.com

links.title: AI Hotel Management Software & PMS | Zaplar
links.description: Zaplar is a frontier agentic operating system for hotels that replaces PMS, POS, Booking engine, and more. It automates hotel operations across bookings, communication, events, and more, saving hotels hours of admin and allows staff to focus on the guest.
